title: Writer Assistant Core candidate storage read/write contract and candidate-only persistence
goal: Define and implement candidate-only JSON persistence for typed Writer Assistant Core candidate records with validation-before-write and path safety before extraction runtime, routes, UI, model calls, apply-promotion, or memory/canon mutation exists.
why_now: PHASE8-IMPL-002 completed pure candidate record validation helpers and pure storage path helpers with no file I/O. The next safe slice is candidate-only persistence contracts and tests before runtime extraction, routes, UI, or model behavior expand.

include: Side-effect expectations for project-local candidate files only.
Candidate index behavior decision and tests, if authorized.
Candidate-only separation from OMI MVP, memory, canon, bible, storyform, scenes, notes, and materials.
exclude: Generated prose, rewriting, continuation, style imitation, or prose improvement.
Semantic search and Story Check auto-runs.
Apply-promotion, OMI candidate promotion, and memory/canon mutation.
Training data, JSONL records, dataset artifacts, and project runtime files.

quality_notes: T001 publishes the parent and child plan only.
PHASE8-IMPL-002 added pure validation and path helpers only; no JSON persistence exists yet.
PHASE8-IMPL-003-T002 accepted write/read persistence contract; list-only in T005/T006; index deferred.
PHASE8-IMPL-003 starts with contract decision and tests before persistence helpers.
List behavior is in-scope after T005 tests; index read/write deferred to later parent.

acceptance_criteria: PHASE8-IMPL-003 is published as the active Writer Assistant Core parent after completed PHASE8-IMPL-002.
PHASE8-IMPL-003-T001 publishes the parent, inventory, enrichment JSON, and roadmap/status updates.
PHASE8-IMPL-003-T002 is identified as the next child task.
Child tasks T001-T007 are documented with tests-first sequencing.
Scope explicitly prioritizes candidate-only JSON persistence before extraction/runtime expansion.
Non-scope explicitly blocks extraction, routes, UI, model calls, persistence in T001, apply-promotion, and memory/canon mutation.
No runtime code, tests, package files, backend/frontend files, project runtime files, training data, JSONL records, or dataset artifacts are changed in T001.

commands: non-LeanCTX whitespace check on changed docs
validation.notes: T001 validation is roadmap/status only. Do not run pytest unless runtime code or tests were accidentally changed.

safety_notes: No generated prose, rewriting, continuation, style imitation, prose improvement, or summaries as durable truth.
Persistence existence does not prove story truth.
Candidate persistence supports review only and does not approve or promote candidates.
OMI remains the central review and future promotion layer.
Promotion records remain audit-only until future apply-promotion exists.
Memory/canon mutation is out of scope.
Persistence helpers must not mutate bible, storyform, scenes, notes, materials, or approved memory/canon.
deferred_work: Index read/write helpers (deferred to PHASE8-IMPL-004 or equivalent).
Project runtime artifacts beyond authorized candidate persistence.
context_tools_policy: T001 does not run context tools.
PHASE8-IMPL-001 T003 already produced targeted context.
PHASE8-IMPL-002 produced the candidate record and storage path contracts.
Additional context tools are not needed for this parent unless a later child explicitly authorizes a narrow collect task.
Context output is evidence, not roadmap truth.
Roadmap truth remains roadmap_index.yaml, implementation_status.md, task records, enrichment JSON, and validation docs.
